metric: Pairs proved equivalent by the z3 prover over all databases meeting the declared keys and NOT NULL columns, with no LLM. Inequivalent pairs stay out of this count.
correctness: 0 false proofs: every proof survives 1,000 further random DuckDB databases and VeriEQL's published counterexamples replayed on DuckDB
caveats: No labels. 9 pairs are not run: 5 whose Calcite text lost a correlated column (WHERE * = t5.DEPTNO), 2 with a subquery in an outer join's ON (DuckDB cannot run it), 1 comparing VARCHAR with INT and 1 naming a renamed lateral column ($cor0.SAL0). Calcite-only spellings ($f0 names, COUNT(a, b), SINGLE_VALUE, FIRST_VALUE, empty select lists, $cor correlation variables, repeated star columns, || as concatenation) are translated as docs/evals/verieql.md describes. 5 refuted pairs are marked equivalent by VeriEQL (80, 120, 126, 257, 367); each counterexample was executed and checked by hand (pair 80 returns 'TABLE' against 'TABLE ': Calcite pads CHAR literals, which DuckDB's VARCHAR does not). One pair (a correlated EXISTS with an unqualified column) is read differently by DuckDB than by VeriEQL. Rules were developed against SQLSolver's Calcite pairs, which overlap this suite (tuned on test). The outer-join flattening rules (src/kumo_sql_prover/outer_join_flatten.py) were written with this suite's failing pairs in view (tuned on test). Measured on master 80ac740, after the structural aggregate rules (src/kumo_sql_prover/aggregate_rules.py, #371). Re-measured on master 4d294afd (sqlglot 30.21, z3-solver 5.1.0.0, an otherwise idle 4-core machine): 315 to 335 proved, 0 wrong. Whether the gain comes from rules merged since 2026-10-02 or from solver timeouts that no longer fire on an idle machine was not separated. Corrected on 2026-11-10: the row had said 335 since 2026-10-04 without being re-measured. Pairs 147 and 204, proved then, are now declined by soundness guards (a string compared with a column the prover cannot type through a derived table; a string compared with a number), which left 333 on master 880288f with the ORDER BY output-name fix. Pair 280 is proved since #861 and was admitted through the executed search, so master 6c7d30d with that fix measures 334. The admission ledger (benchmarks/admitted/verieql-calcite-proof.txt) now fails the gate when this count and the proved pairs disagree. Measured on 2026-11-10 on commit e904d62: 334 to 335. Pair 147 is proved again: a bare column that only one derived table in scope can supply is tied to that derived table's column, so its declared VARCHAR is followed through the projection (string_number_compare.py); the rule was written with that pair in view (tuned on test), and the proof went through the admission checks. Pair 204 stays unknown: its right side lines up ENAME with DEPTNO by position, a string against a number.
